title: Outstanding syntax
body: Every syntax change or addition open in foam as of 2026-11-23. Syntax stays provisional until one rework after these land (see CLAUDE.md), so each piece takes the form Jack accepted on 2026-11-23 or the plainest one the parser reads, logged on acre-4518a5.
close_reason: All 12 children landed on dev between 0d8260b and 4c45d30, each with its provisional syntax logged on acre-4518a5 for the rework.
